pr.title: Add activity logging for explicit user logout
pr.body:
## Scope

What's changed:

- Added `LOGOUT` action type to the Action enum in `@directus/constants`
- Added activity logging to `authenticationService.logout()` in `api/src/services/authentication.ts`, mirroring the existing `LOGIN` pattern

## Potential Risks / Drawbacks

 - Only covers explicit/user-initiated logouts (via `POST /auth/logout`). Passive session terminations (token expiration, forced logouts from password changes, user suspension) are not logged
 - If `this.accountability` is not set on the service for any reason, the logout activity will silently not be logged (same behavior as login)


## Tested Scenarios

 - Explicit logout via `POST /auth/logout` (Local, LDAP, OAuth2, OIDC auth methods)
 - SAML logout via `POST /auth/logout/saml/:provider` (calls authService.logout() internally) 🔴 [Not Tested]
 - Verified activity record is created with correct action, user, IP, user agent, and origin

## Review Notes / Questions

 - The change follows the exact same pattern as the existing LOGIN activity logging
 - All auth methods (Local, LDAP, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML) flow through the same `logout()` method, so a single code change covers all providers
 - Passive session terminations (expiry, admin-forced) are intentionally excluded from this scope — could be a follow-up if needed


## Checklist

- [ ] Added or updated tests
- [x] Documentation PR not required
- [x] OpenAPI package PR not required

---

Fixes #\<num\>

reviews.body: Should we add a tab for viewing logout events in the app? We have one already for login https://github.com/directus/directus/blob/main/app/src/modules/activity/components/navigation.vue#L103

The action text seems to be missing from the activity record. 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/eee1de28-cec2-4d1b-9ff5-06658204e9de


This should be fixed by adding a translation for "logout" in the en-US translation file at `field_options.directus_activity.logout`. 

As we are already here thoughts on adding a fallback to raw value if no translation is present? Not a blocker. [Relevant code](https://github.com/directus/directus/blob/main/app/src/modules/activity/routes/item.vue#L82)
